newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Bank sees upturn for mid-sized Swiss firms.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Bank sees upturn for mid-sized Swiss firms.

text.p: Most small and mid-sized Swiss companies have become cautiously optimistic about the outlook for sales and earnings growth, a Swiss Bank Corp survey found, although a broad-based economic recovery is not yet in sight.

"While a few sectors, such as the hotel industry and travel agencies, have seen sharp increases in business, the outlook for other sectors, construction in particular, has grown even dimmer," SBC said.

The survey showed that business conditions for small and mid-sized companies stopped deteriorating for the first time since 1994. Not only are large international firms reporting rising orders, but a broad range of small companies in both manufacturing and services are more upbeat.

The overall demand trend remains weak for the time being because of the continuing restructuring phase in construction, it said. "Thus the sales and earnings trends over the coming months will not show any significant improvement."
The semi-annual survey covers 1,500 companies with fewer than 100 employees in 13 industries as well as large companies.
